title: A normal experience
description: a modpack that offers a regular Minecraft experience, what more are you expecting?
body: An atmospheric horror Minecraft modpack that trades cheap jump scares for slow-burning tension. Instead of flooding the game with overpowered monsters, it focuses on mood: darker nights, oppressive fog, unsettling ambient sounds, and subtle visual tweaks that make familiar biomes feel uncanny. You’re still playing Minecraft — gathering, building, surviving — but every cave, every forest edge, and every distant noise feels just a bit wrong, as if something is watching you from the shadows… and maybe it actually is.
